selection_rule: Named lending markets selected before classification to cover Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Arbitrum and to include both general-purpose and chain-relevant markets. Every selected protocol must have a complete observation window before a below-threshold result can support zero.
interpretation: DeFiLlama token TVL is a screening proxy for supplied balances, not proof that every balance is collateral-enabled. A positive VA_COLLATERAL decision additionally requires point-in-time protocol eligibility evidence.
